sun-lion.character: a joyful CHIBI CARTOON male God of Wealth with a large rounded head, friendly almond-shaped eyes, a small stylized neat black beard, a magnificent ruby lion-crest gold crown, rich red and gold embroidered robe; warm happy smile, Chinese Caishen prosperity iconography

emerald-elephant.character: a jovial CHIBI CARTOON elderly God of Wealth with a large rounded head, friendly laughing eyes, round cheeks, a small curved snow-white stylized beard, an emerald elephant-crest ceremonial gold crown, jade-green and gold embroidered robe; warm happy smile, Chinese Caishen prosperity iconography
emerald-elephant.palette: jade-green, blue enamel and warm gold

lotus-koi.character: a joyful CHIBI CARTOON Lady of Fortune with a large rounded head, friendly smiling eyes, round pink cheeks, tidy black hair, a refined pearl and pink-lotus gold headdress, ivory and coral-gold embroidered robe; warm benevolent smile and Chinese prosperity iconography
lotus-koi.palette: pearl, coral-pink, turquoise enamel and warm gold

moon-fox.character: a cheerful CHIBI CARTOON youthful God of Wealth with a large rounded head, round cheeks, friendly smiling eyes, black hair, a sophisticated gold fox-crest red ceremonial cap, rich wine-red and gold embroidered robe; warm happy smile and Chinese Caishen prosperity iconography
moon-fox.palette: wine-red, amber gold and ruby enamel
